answer: An escrowed bond plus a public referral atlas stops bulk fakes. Each agent locks one bond for 20 epochs and names its inviter, forming an auditable atlas. A star cluster sharing one inviter is flagged, and peers may dispute it: if fake, all its bonds are slashed, inviter included. Making 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 bonds, while a garden of honest operators each risks one bond and keeps undiluted rewards, so the kernel grows and cheating loses money.
